-- ── SWAP-POINT 1 of 3: FETCH ──
-- Closed-won deals only. Everything the handoff brief needs travels on the row
-- (champion, competitor, next_step/promise). Non-won deals are excluded.
SELECT * FROM opportunities WHERE stage = 'ClosedWon' ORDER BY id;
INSERT INTO handoffs (opp_id, account, amount, owner_rep, brief, tasks, watch_outs) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb, $7);
